'''Force Commander''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] used by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]'s [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Expansionary Fleet]] that signified command over a frontier patrol group such as [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]]. [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was the youngest [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] to ever achieve this position.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
